papers.title_en: GUIDE: Designer-in-the-loop Authoring of Conformant Generative User Interfaces
papers.authors: Hyewon Lee, Ziying Wang, Aiden Moy, Saran Nagubandi, Jason Wu
papers.evidence: 生成式界面依据用户需求与上下文自适应，并通过提示优化适配
papers.tldr: 生成式用户界面（GenUI）能按用户需求与上下文即时生成界面，但仍须体现设计者意图并符合品牌规范。由于设计者无法直接指定或预览每个生成结果，设计意图难以落实。GUIDE 是面向设计者的 GenUI 开发环境，通过持续检查与编辑，利用提示优化和自适应一致性评分模型来适配生成行为。其评分模型在真实与合成应用截图的留出比较中达到或超过专有 LLM 基线；12 名 UI/UX 从业者研究显示 GUIDE 有效易用，且显著偏好其对齐输出。
papers.abstract_en: Generative User Interfaces (GenUIs) enable applications to generate interfaces on demand from user needs and context. Like conventional UIs, they must still reflect designers' intent and conform to requirements such as brand identity. Unlike conventional UIs, designers cannot directly specify or see every interface a GenUI may produce, making design intent harder to enforce. We introduce GUIDE (GenUI Development Environment), a system that lets designers continuously inspect and refine GenUI behavior as they create and edit interfaces. GUIDE uses designers' modifications and interactions to adapt GenUIs through prompt optimization and a novel adaptive conformance scoring model. We validate GUIDE's scoring model and system. The scoring model matched or outperformed proprietary LLM baselines on held-out comparisons of real and synthetic application screens. In a study with 12 UI/UX practitioners, participants found GUIDE effective and usable and significantly preferred aligned outputs over a strong baseline using exemplars and a model-generated design.md.
